snippet.title: Microsoft Baseball 3D 1998 Edition Gameplay Cleveland Indians vs. Seattle Mariners
snippet.description: Hello everyone, it's time for some baseball! Today, I want to introduce you to a fun and nostalgic game: Microsoft Baseball 3D 1998 Edition. I was running it using the Windows 98 emulator, PCem v17. Let's take a look at the game footage together.
